findings.title: ContextualLoggerMiddleware panics on nil request
findings.body: ContextualLoggerMiddleware.QueryData, CallResource, CheckHealth and CollectMetrics in pkg/services/pluginsintegration/clientmiddleware/contextual_logger_middleware.go dereference req (e.g. req.PluginContext) without a nil check. LoggerMiddleware in the same chain explicitly handles req == nil, proving nil requests are expected. Since CreateMiddlewares registers ContextualLoggerMiddleware before LoggerMiddleware, a nil request panics in the outer middleware before it ever reaches the nil guard, crashing the call instead of delegating to next.

findings.title: MetricsMiddleware panics on nil request
findings.body: MetricsMiddleware.QueryData iterates req.Queries and reads req.PluginContext, and CallResource/CheckHealth/CollectMetrics read req.PluginContext/req.Body, without checking req == nil. LoggerMiddleware shows nil requests must be tolerated. MetricsMiddleware is outermost in CreateMiddlewares, so a nil request panics here before LoggerMiddleware's nil guard can handle it.

findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext discards logs under test
findings.body: TestLogger.FromContext in pkg/plugins/log/fake.go ignores both receiver and context and returns a brand-new empty TestLogger. LoggerMiddleware now logs via m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...), so the Info call is recorded on a temporary object that is immediately discarded. A test that injects NewTestLogger into LoggerMiddleware and asserts on InfoLogs.Calls/Message on the original will always see zero calls, making the middleware untestable and hiding regressions.

findings.title: Adding FromContext breaks Logger implementers
findings.body: Adding FromContext(ctx context.Context) Logger to the Logger interface in pkg/plugins/log/ifaces.go breaks every existing implementation of the old 5-method interface. Any out-of-tree mock or custom logger that satisfied the old interface no longer compiles against the new interface. A rename chore should not silently introduce a breaking public-interface change without migration or adapter.

findings.title: FromContext fallback drops contextual attributes
findings.body: grafanaInfraLogWrapper.FromContext in pkg/plugins/log/logger.go type-asserts the infra logger result to *log.ConcreteLogger and on failure returns d.New(), a fresh logger with no context. If the underlying logger returns any other Logger implementation, all contextual attributes added by ContextualLoggerMiddleware (endpoint, pluginId, dsName, dsUID, uname) are silently discarded and Plugin Request Completed logs lose plugin identification. It should preserve the returned logger or the original instead of discarding context.

findings.title: Logger loses plugin fields and traceID
findings.body: LoggerMiddleware in pkg/services/pluginsintegration/clientmiddleware/logger_middleware.go no longer logs pluginId, endpoint, uname, dsName, dsUID and traceID explicitly and relies solely on m.logger.FromContext(ctx). The context populated by ContextualLoggerMiddleware contains endpoint/pluginId/dsName/dsUID/uname but never adds traceID, and the old explicit tracing.TraceIDFromContext handling was deleted. Plugin Request Completed logs therefore lose trace correlation and depend entirely on an outer middleware being present; used alone they contain no plugin identification.

findings.title: MetricsMiddleware reuses single shared instance
findings.body: NewMetricsMiddleware in pkg/services/pluginsintegration/clientmiddleware/metrics_middleware.go creates one MetricsMiddleware once and on each middleware creation does imw.next = next and returns the same pointer. If the middleware decorates more than one client chain, each decoration overwrites the previous chain's next pointer, misrouting requests, and concurrent decoration races. NewContextualLoggerMiddleware in the same PR correctly allocates a new struct per call; MetricsMiddleware should do the same.

findings.title: No test for new contextual logger behavior
findings.body: After the split, pkg/services/pluginsintegration/clientmiddleware/metrics_middleware_test.go still defines TestInstrumentationMiddleware testing only counters/histograms, and there are no tests for the new ContextualLoggerMiddleware (context attributes, ordering relative to LoggerMiddleware, nil requests) nor for LoggerMiddleware's new FromContext dependency. A regression that drops plugin context or panics on nil would go undetected.
